name: The Hussar Grill George
address: Courtenay Street, Caledon St, George Central, George, 6530, South Africa
description_short: Classic steakhouse in George Central serving prime cuts and timeless grills in a welcoming atmosphere.
description_long:
The Hussar Grill brings its celebrated steakhouse tradition to George Central, occupying a prime spot on Courtenay Street where the aroma of wood-fired grills draws diners in. The interior strikes that perfect balance between smart and comfortable—dark wood, brass accents, and white tablecloths without the stuffiness.

The menu centres on what they do best: perfectly aged beef cuts grilled to your specification, from tender fillets to generous T-bones. House favourites include their signature rump with garlic butter and the famous Hussar burger for those seeking something heartier. Starters like calamari strips and mushroom pots set the tone, while sides of creamed spinach and onion rings are generous enough to share.

Service is attentive without hovering, and the central George location makes it an easy choice whether you're a local or passing through the Garden Route. The wine list features solid South African options that complement the meat-focused menu, and the consistent quality explains why this spot has built such a loyal following in the area.
